cases.title: Esc at CD's third point cancels the pipe, draws nothing and opens no pipe window
cases.expected: After CD with two typed points the command waits for the third point; one Esc prints '[CE] CD command cancelled.', no New Pipe window opens, nothing new is left in the drawing (no polyline, arrow or text), and the Civil log holds one 'Command outcome: CD cancelled'. The contrast run (two points then Enter) opens New Pipe.
cases.why_not_unit: The result depends on AutoCAD's live point prompt answering Esc during real point collection and on nothing being drawn before the pipe window.
not_automated: The contrast run's pipe is not drawn (the New Pipe window is only opened and then cancelled), so the 'exactly one pipe with two vertices' half of card assertion 3 is not checked.
The exact words of the third-point prompt are recorded, not asserted.

cases.title: After CDEDIT the pipes you had selected are still selected
cases.expected: Pick pipe P3 (10A98D) first, run CDEDIT, answer Y, press Save in Edit Pipe with nothing changed: the selection is still exactly 10A98D. Then pick P3 and the new pipe together, run CDEDIT, close the editor that opens by its Cancel: the selection is still exactly those two. No CE window is left open at the end.
cases.why_not_unit: Selection restore runs against AutoCAD's live implied selection after a real modal window.
not_automated: The title of the batch editor for two pipes is recorded, not asserted (the card does not name it). If no editor closes by Cancel the step is BLOCKED.
Whether the first Save changed the drawing is not checked (the drawing's change counter is not read).
